rules: Site DNA is website-level memory, not per-page memory.
Explicit user requests override remembered DNA.
Local element/section edits do not rewrite website DNA unless explicitly global.
Successful global token/theme/rebrand operations may update DNA.
Failed operations never become authoritative DNA.
Partial execution only persists verified global parts.
Sibling pages inherit DNA but may use different compatible Sparks and composition.
DNA stores concise durable decisions, not conversation transcripts.
Unknown values stay absent rather than being invented.
